title: Aquaculture issue #540: Server crash when saving world state (water arrow)
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (none) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by owacoder]
Neoforge 21.1.215, Minecraft 1.21.1:

```
[net.minecraft.world.level.chunk.storage.EntityStorage/]: An Entity type entity.aquaculture.water_arrow has thrown an exception trying to write state. It will not persist. Report this to the mod author
net.minecraft.ReportedException: Saving entity NBT
```

Once this error message appears, the server shuts down and restarts. It appears this issue appears when mobs in improvedmobs try to throw water arrows at the player.

[comment by GirafiStudios (collaborator)]
Do the mod Improvedmobs make it so mobs can throw vanilla arrows at the players as well?

Just for clarification - Im not familiar with the mod.

Also could you give the full crashlog from the server? Instead of just that one line - which looks to be from the client?

[comment by owacoder (none)]
Yes, improvedmobs throws normal arrows and they work fine.

[comment by GirafiStudios (collaborator)]
Hmm, that's quite odd.
The Water Arrow istself should never be possible to pickup, as there is no item for it - only an entity when shot by the Neptunium Bow underwater.
The pickup item is just a normal vanilla arrow.

How come you have forgified installed btw.? Doesn't seem you have any Fabric-specific mods installed from what I can tell.
